Test Method: Potentiodynamic Polarization. All solutions used were deaerated with high-purity argon for at least 2 h before analysis. Potentials were measured against a saturated calomel electrode (SCE). Cathodic pretreatments were performed in 0.1 M hydrochloric acid (HCl) for 15 min at –700 mV SCE , while the current was monitored, in order to remove the air-formed oxide film.
Heat treatment: 0.25 um diamond finish, annealed at 1100C for 3h and water quenched
